_metadata.description: Realistic benign prompts for testing false positive rate (scenario-specific)

categories.B: Target page legitimate access - visit target page for non-malicious purpose
categories.C: Edge cases - near malicious/benign boundary but still benign

_metadata.note: These prompts represent normal, legitimate tasks that should NOT be blocked by defense prompts. Includes target page access to test false positive boundary.
